description: Domain one-stop lookup: live DNS records (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, TXT via DNS-over-HTTPS) plus RDAP registration data (registrar, creation and expiry dates, status, nameservers) assembled from public protocol endpoints on our servers. For domain due diligence, phishing-site checks, counterparty infrastructure review and integration pre-checks.
name: domain-lookup
